livekit-client 2.22.0
Downloaded 2026-08-25 from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/livekit-client@2.22.0/dist/livekit-client.umd.js

Vendored rather than hotlinked on purpose. A venue join page must not depend on
a CDN reachable from the audience's phones: conference wifi routinely blocks or
throttles third party origins, and a page that cannot load its client library
is a room full of people hearing nothing.

Pinned to an exact version. Re-download deliberately, and test on a phone
before an event.
